Parts & diagrams▾

No tool matches. Try “graph”, “atom” or “fraction”.

Math tools▾

Click one to drop it in at the playhead. It opens in the Shapes list below — type your own numbers there and it redraws, writing itself in step by step. Drag it to move, drag its corner dot to resize.

Science & 3D tools▾

Same as the math tools: click to drop it in, then edit its numbers in the Shapes list. 3D solids show volume and surface area and can spin while they play.
Scroll to pan · Shift+scroll to pan sideways

Shapes▾

Click a shape on the canvas to select it (Shift-click for more). Then: Delete removes it, arrow keys nudge it, Ctrl+C / Ctrl+V copies it.
